plan.title: Your picks
items: Wafer: 1C plus your ending, written up as draft 1D.
Goodbye: your own lines, written up as draft 2D. Hands, then fade to white.

plan.title: The questions, on my judgement
items: Q1 'bit like dying' said aloud: kept. You asked for them to know.
Q2 'Less than the last five years': Maddie's, said softly.
Q3 the old lady: silent in both dialogues.
Q4 the seat row: already planted (scene A and the walk out), not needed now, since 2D drops it.
Q5 lie or concession: moot, 2D is yours.

plan.title: You decide
items: The crossing picture: your note says hands then fade to white is perfect. I'd keep that and drop the new shots (slack hand, cold tea, lights out one by one), unless you want the lights going out inside the fade.

replies.1-1C: Done as 1D: 1C plus your ending in Maddie's last line, "Back to before it all went wrong. And you'll be there. Still you. And this time, we've got a chance to fix it." 'Not this you' before it keeps the cost real. About 25 s.
replies.2: Done as 2D, your words: Sandra "You know what? I'm looking forward to hanging out with you. Before the world ended." / Derek "Yes, me too, love. Are you ready for this?" then hands and fade to white.
replies.q4: Planted in scene A and the walk out; 2D no longer needs it.

kai_round1.1-1C: I like this cut, let's pick, count the chairs, 1C, I think at the end we need to say you will be there before it all, you'll still be you, before it went wrong, and we'll have a chance to fix it, because that's the inspiring call to any viewer, because that's them right now watching this video.
kai_round1.2: So, I think that I quite like, I think with Sandra and me, we should go like, do you know I'm going to look forward to hanging out with you before the world ended. I think that's what Sandra should say. And then I think Derek should say yes love, are you ready for this? Because I think that's really great. So, let's keep it how it is now, but Sandra should say I'm looking forward to hanging out with Derek before the world ended. I think that's the cute way to end this. And then, yeah, Derek saying yes me too love, are you ready for this? Because them holding hands and then the screen fading white is perfect.
